identity: Michael V57 repository-backed owner exterior truth set

repositoryBinding.note: Actual owner-supplied JPEG binaries. Semantic aliases below are authoritative bridges between scene-graph, judge, reconstruction and owner-photo names.

observations: Lower lamp assemblies are horizontal rounded-rectangle pods with red perimeter, dark internal housing, and offset rectangular lens areas.
Upper DRL/headlamp strip is very thin and visually integrated with the Citroen chevron/chrome line.
Central grille is wide, low, rounded-rectangular and mesh-filled with a thin contrasting perimeter.
Front fender extensions are multi-plane black aero pieces, not simple smooth arches.
Front splitter projects clearly ahead of the bumper face.
Hood-side vents are recessed black mesh openings.
Roof scoop is low, rectangular, forward-facing, white with red center treatment.
Rear wing has a broad upper plane, large shaped vertical endplates and a secondary lower aero element/support plane.
Rear bumper has deep corner openings with contrasting perimeter trim.
Rear diffuser uses multiple pronounced vertical fins and a centered exhaust treatment.
Taillights are rounded-rectangular with internal lens segmentation rather than thin red bars.
Front fascia is strongly bilateral and much wider through the black grille/lower-bumper region than current simplified geometry.
Lower lamp pods are horizontally elongated and positioned outboard of the grille.
DRL strips remain extremely thin and sit above the lower lamp pods.
Front arch aero and splitter create a wide planted stance.
Right-side front geometry confirms matching lamp-pod width/depth and multi-plane arch treatment from the opposite side.
Hood vents sit high and outboard near the fender shoulders and are visibly recessed mesh pieces.
Front lamp pod depth is substantial, not a flat decal-like treatment.
Side view is the primary proportion anchor for wheelbase, wheel diameter, overhangs, roofline, windshield rake, greenhouse and rocker height.
Front arch is black and heavily extended while rear arch remains predominantly body-color red.
Long black lower-door insert and rearward side vent are major side identity features.
Thin yellow skirt accent runs near the lower rocker edge.
Rear wing sits high and rearward with visible endplate depth.
Rear three-quarter confirms wing endplate size, lower aero plane and the depth of the hatch/bumper relationship.
Rear quarter includes a black vent/aero insert bordered by a yellow accent.
Rear bumper corner opening and diffuser geometry are deep three-dimensional features.
Straight rear is the primary symmetry/proportion anchor for wing width, hatch width, taillight placement, bumper opening placement and diffuser width.
Diffuser has five pronounced fin regions beneath the bumper.
Central rear recess and exhaust treatment sit on the vehicle centerline.
Wing spans almost the full body width and endplates extend well above/below the upper plane.
